subject: BlueHaven: request for IR plan + evidence intake and timeline
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@bluehaven.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@bluehaven.com>, security@bluehaven.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: evidence & IRP intake for auth spike (BlueHaven account)

Hi Logan,

We observed an unusual authentication spike from a subset of BlueHaven test tenants on 2026-07-19 (approx 03:40–04:10 UTC) that correlated with elevated error rates in our integration. Our security and procurement teams need two things to close the loop on our vendor assessment: a copy of Redwood's incident response plan (SOC2 / SIG / CAIQ-relevant sections) and a lightweight evidence bundle showing the retention windows and a sample of sanitized telemetry around that time window.

Specifically, can you provide:
- The current IR plan PDF (or a link) with SOC 2 contact points and escalation paths.
- A SIG/CAIQ mapping or pointer to where we can find the control mappings for incident notification and telemetry retention.
- A small sample of logs/telemetry covering 2026-07-19 03:30–04:30 UTC (sanitized, redacted PII) and a short note on retention policy for auth/logging events.
- Expected timeline for delivery and whether any legal/POC approvals are needed.

We need this package to satisfy an expedited compliance review — target turnaround is EOD Monday 2026-07-26 if possible. If you need an intake form from us, attached is the minimal procurement form.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Senior InfoSec Manager — BlueHaven Financial
security@bluehaven.com

Attachment: bluehaven-request-form-20260720.pdf_stub
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@bluehaven.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: evidence & IRP intake for auth spike (BlueHaven account)

Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up and the form. We're on it. High-level plan below; I'll own coordination.

Plan / owners:
- IRP and SIG/CAIQ mapping: Marissa (Security) will share the SOC2-aligned IRP extract and the SIG mapping for incident notification controls.
- Telemetry sample & retention note: Karthik (Infra/Observability) will produce a sanitized log bundle (redacted IPs/IDs) and a short retention summary.
- Legal/Procurement: If ProcureOps require an NDA or additional PO, please flag in reply; otherwise we can treat this as evidence-sharing under our existing customer agreement.

Delivery ETA: preliminary package by Fri 2026-07-23 EOD (PST), final sanitized packet and brief post-incident note by Mon 2026-07-26 EOD. If you need faster, we can prioritize the IRP + retention summary first.

I'll attach the IRP extract now.

--
Logan Wright
Director, Customer Security Programs | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf_stub

Thanks Logan — that timeline works. Two quick clarifications before you deliver the sample logs: 

1) Please confirm the redaction approach you will use (we need IPs and tenant IDs removed, but correlation IDs okay if pseudonymized).
2) For the IRP extract, can you highlight the parts that cover customer notification SLAs and time-to-detect/time-to-contain targets? Our risk team wants explicit SLOs called out.

Also: we will require a short postmortem once your team completes internal analysis (high level is fine; we will handle any redaction/attestation requests on our side).

If you can provide a share link or SFTP details for the artifacts that would be preferred.

Appreciate it —
Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: evidence & IRP intake for auth spike (BlueHaven account) — package delivered

Elena —

Attached is the sanitized bundle and our brief retrospective. Summary below.

What we delivered:
- redwood-sanitized-logs-20260720.tar.gz_stub (contains redacted auth logs covering 2026-07-19 03:30–04:30 UTC). Correlation IDs have been pseudonymized; user IDs and IPs removed per your ask.
- Redwood_IRP_v2.3.pdf_stub (IRP extract; sections 3.2/4.1 note customer notification SLOs). We've annotated the PDF with callouts for notification SLA: detect (median 6–10 min), contain (aim <60 min for priority incidents), and customer notify (initial contact within 4 hours for incidents impacting availability/confidentiality).
- redwood-postmortem-20260725.pdf_stub (high-level root cause and mitigations — we redact specific tenant identifiers as agreed).

Retention and legal notes:
- Auth events: retained raw for 90 days; aggregated telemetry 1 year.
- Evidence access: for transfer we used a pre-authorized SFTP share; link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/bluehaven/IRP-v2.3 (access limited by token).
- If you require a signed attestation for the postmortem, please indicate and we will coordinate with Legal.

Next steps / asks from BlueHaven:
- Confirm receipt and whether the pseudonymization is sufficient.
- If you want a deeper timeline with internal runbook steps, we can provide a redacted timeline runbook within three business days.

Thanks — looping Karthik in for any follow-up on telemetry schema.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
